headline: The US embassy said on Saturday that the Mehrgarh Museum in Quetta will reopen later this month after a US-funded preservation project, Arab News reports.

card.desc: US Embassy: Quetta ka museum isi mahine dobara khulega

caption:
8,000 saal purani Mehrgarh tehzeeb ka museum dobara khulega!
Arab News ke mutabiq US Embassy ne Saturday ko bataya ke Quetta ka Mehrgarh Museum US ke funded preservation project ke baad isi mahine dobara khulega, magar tareekh abhi nahi batayi gayi. Project mein Neolithic nawadraat ki hifazat, displays ki behtari aur maqami mahireen ki training shamil thi.
Kya aap ne kabhi Mehrgarh ke baare mein suna hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
